steps.title: Initialize Android project structure
steps.description: Setting up the basic directories and configuration files required for a new Android application.

steps.title: Generate app-meta.json
steps.description: Creating the application metadata file containing the app name and package name.

steps.title: Configure app-level build.gradle
steps.description: Setting up the app's build configuration, including SDK versions, Java compatibility, and application ID.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Defining the application's core components, permissions, and entry points in the Android manifest file.

steps.title: Define strings.xml resources
steps.description: Creating the strings resource file to define the application's name.

steps.title: Design activity_main.xml layout
steps.description: Creating the XML layout file for the main activity, displaying 'Hello World!' text.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java
steps.description: Writing the Java code for MainActivity, which loads the 'activity_main' layout.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compatibility
steps.description: Ensuring that the generated Java code adheres to Java 8 language features only, avoiding newer constructs.

steps.title: Check manifest activity declaration
steps.description: Confirming that MainActivity is properly declared in AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate intent filters.

steps.title: Confirm application theme and icon
steps.description: Verifying that the manifest uses the specified Theme.Material.Light and the default drawable icon.

steps.title: Final review of project files
steps.description: Conducting a comprehensive check of all generated files for consistency and adherence to build rules.

steps.title: Building Hello World App
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the Android application into an APK file.
